SANYA SIBAL  +91- 8284008771  sanya.sibal05@gmail.com

 Employment History

Manager, EY Global Delivery Services  August 2024 - Present  Gurgaon

Led ESG advisory and assurance engagements across CSRD, ESRS, and ISSB,

delivering gap assessments, implementation roadmaps, and regulatory compliance

strategies.

Advised C-suite stakeholders on sustainability disclosures, aligning ESG reporting

with risk management, value creation, and investor expectations.

Established and scaled a Double Materiality CoE, standardizing methodologies

through templates, repositories, and AI-enabled solutions.

Delivered double materiality assessments, DMA gap analyses, and governance

integration across healthcare, pharma, and F&B sectors.

Defined ESG Suite product roadmap and led ESG platform enhancements aligned

with CSRD and ISSB reporting requirements.

Led CSRD Barometer and ESG benchmarking initiatives, developing disclosure

assessment, scoring, and market intelligence frameworks.

Developed energy transition strategies, transition plans, and ESG rating improvement

frameworks using peer benchmarking and best practices.

Directed EU Taxonomy eligibility, alignment, DNSH, minimum safeguards

assessments, and limited assurance engagements.

Led client workshops, regulatory walkthroughs, and quality reviews, ensuring

compliance with sustainability reporting and assurance methodologies.

Supported business development

through RFPs, ESG maturity assessments,

regulatory landscaping, and thought leadership initiatives.

Assistant Manager - Sustainability, EZ-XBRL Solutions  August 2022 - July 2024  Mumbai

Orchestrated ESG platform development and predictive ESG rating model

implementation in collaboration with analytics, research, and product teams.

Drove requirements gathering, solution design, and ESG reporting framework

integration across business workflows.

Led implementation of Materiality Assessment, CSRD, GRI, TCFD, SASB, CDP, ESG

disclosures, validation, and reporting capabilities.

Directed UAT, stakeholder engagement, and regulatory compliance alignment to

optimize platform effectiveness.

Managed project execution, user adoption, documentation, and continuous

enhancement of ESG reporting and analytics capabilities.

Spearheaded carbon accounting, GHG inventory management, and Scope 1, 2 & 3

emissions quantification initiatives.

Established E S G performance scorecards, KPI frameworks, and executive

dashboards to drive sustainability governance and decision-making.

Institutionalized ESG governance frameworks, policies, controls, and compliance

mechanisms to strengthen sustainability oversight.

Research Specialist - Information Technology, S&P Capital IQ (India) Pvt. Ltd.  September 2021 - July 2022  Gurgaon

Led Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA) framework development, ESG

methodology enhancement, and questionnaire design aligned with evolving

sustainability standards.

Supported Fortune 500 companies on ESG strategy, investor reporting, materiality

assessment, and integration of ESG factors into investment decision-making.

Performed ESG research, due diligence, risk assessment, and sustainability

benchmarking across supply chains, disclosures, and reporting frameworks including

CDP and TCFD.

Conducted secondary research, competitive intelligence, and market analysis to

identify emerging technology and sustainability trends.

Performed data analysis, benchmarking, and due diligence to support strategic

decision-making and risk assessment.

Developed research frameworks, assessment methodologies, and evaluation criteria

for large-scale industry and company analysis.

Analyzed corporate disclosures, industry reports, and regulatory developments to

generate actionable business insights.

Managed stakeholder engagement and advisory support for Fortune 500 clients

across ESG, technology, and business transformation initiatives.



 Profile Summary

Results-driven ESG and Sustainability professional with extensive experience leading ESG strategy development, sustainability reporting, climate risk assessments, carbon accounting, ESG regulatory compliance programs across diverse industries. Possessing deep expertise in global reporting and disclosure frameworks, including CSRD, GRI, TCFD, SASB, and CDP, with a strong track record of translating complex sustainability requirements into actionable business strategies. Skilled in conducting materiality decarbonization roadmaps, managing stakeholder engagement, enhancing ESG disclosures, and supporting organizations in meeting evolving regulatory and investor expectations.

Associate, Arabesque S-Ray GmbH  December 2020 - August 2021  New Delhi

Developed ESG market intelligence and client pitch books covering sustainable

finance, debt capital markets, peer analysis, and industry trends.

Established ESG delivery capabilities, including team onboarding, framework design,

and SFDR-aligned methodology development.

Executed materiality assessments and stakeholder engagement to identify, evaluate,

and prioritize key ESG topics.

Partnered with European origination teams to deliver ESG consulting, ratings

assessment, and sustainability performance enhancement initiatives.

Performed ESG data analysis, peer benchmarking, and sustainability research to

support client engagements.

Conducted ESG ratings gap assessments and identified improvement opportunities

across key sustainability frameworks.

Business Analyst, Evalueserve Pvt. Ltd.  January 2018 - March 2020  Gurgaon

Designed ESG methodologies, regional products, and QA processes; led project

execution and analyst capability building for 30+ analysts.

Directed global ESG research and environmental assessment teams across India,

Romania, and Chile, managing 40+ analysts.

Built ESG assessment models leveraging SASB, TCFD, and CDP frameworks;

supported EU Taxonomy, impact measurement, and benchmarking initiatives.

Performed ESG due diligence, data analytics, company benchmarking, sector

intelligence, and risk evaluation; led a 14-member team and stakeholder engagement.

Quality Analyst, H&S Software Development and Knowledge Management Centre Pvt. Ltd.  February 2017 - November 2017  Gurgaon

Performed ESG-focused company analysis, sector mapping, industry classification,

corporate hierarchy validation, and M&A research.

Developed company

intelligence reports covering business overview,

financial

analysis, leadership profiling, competitive benchmarking, analyst insights, and SWOT

analysis.

Led cross-sector equity research reviews and supported corporate diversity initiatives.

Senior Associate - Operations, WNS Global Services Pvt. Ltd.  August 2014 - December 2016  Gurgaon

Performed company analysis, peer benchmarking, and market intelligence research

using Bloomberg, Factiva, Hoovers, and OneSource to support leadership decision-

making.

Facilitated onboarding, knowledge transfer, and process training for new hires on

internal systems and workflows.

Supervised a team of 14 members, managing resource allocation, stakeholder

communication, operational support, quality feedback, and team performance.
